We are looking for a proactive and organized Human Resources Coordinator to manage day-to-day HR operations and support the full employee lifecycle, ensuring smooth HR processes and compliance with Qatar Labour Law.
Manage the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, confirmation, and offboarding.
Coordinate recruitment, candidate screening, interviews, and hiring documentation.

Monitor attendance, leave, timesheets, and payroll inputs in coordination with Finance.
Manage employee benefits, medical insurance, and end-of-service procedures.
Coordinate employee visas, work permits, renewals, and cancellations.
Handle employee relations, inquiries, grievances, and disciplinary documentation.
Ensure compliance with Qatar Labour Law and company policies.

Previous experience in HR operations or a similar position.

High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
